approvers: Owner decides; site manager on compatibility
reason: I pay about €12 per m² all-in for film and tape with my own labour and it works well enough. €19 per m² is over 50% more, and our spend is only about €7,900 a year, so there is little saving to chase and a lot of hassle.
objection: I do not want a coating on coated glass and finished frames. If the peel leaves residue or marks the frames, I carry the cost and the client sees it. For that risk I want it cheaper than film, not dearer.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and board with tape, applied and removed by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: Price at or below about €12 per m² all-in, plus a written guarantee on coated glass and frames, and a reference from a Maltese glazing contractor who has used it with no marks.
